sentences.en: Sometimes hockey players get so competitive that fights break out.
sentences.zh: 1. 有时候冰球运动员会变得非常竞争以至于会发生斗殴。

sentences.en: I'll drop in on you sometime in the near future.
sentences.zh: 2. 我会在不久的将来找个时间来看你。

sentences.en: The oil in mayonnaise sometimes separates from the other ingredients.
sentences.zh: 3. 沙拉酱里的油有时会和其他成分分离。
